# Data Source: tfe_registry_provider

Gets a public or private provider from the private registry.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeRegistryProvider.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        new DataTfeRegistryProvider(this, "example", new DataTfeRegistryProviderConfig()
                .name("my-provider")
                .organization("my-org-name")
                );
    }
}
```

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeRegistryProvider.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        new DataTfeRegistryProvider(this, "example", new DataTfeRegistryProviderConfig()
                .name("aws")
                .namespace("hashicorp")
                .organization("my-org-name")
                .registryName("public")
                );
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the provider.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the provider. Required if `registryName` is `public`. For private providers this is the same as the `organization`.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `registryName` (String) Whether this is a publicly maintained provider or private. Must be either `public` or `private`.

### Read-Only

- `createdAt` (String) The time when the provider was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the provider.
- `updatedAt` (String) The time when the provider was last updated.
